name: Synergetic
note: Russian maker of eco household chemicals (Nizhny Novgorod; synergetic.ru). Official partner of HC Shanghai Dragons per the club's 2026-27 partner page. Ownership on file: ООО «Синергетик» is 100% held by Planet Synergetic C Limited (Mauritius) per an EGRUL excerpt on Checko; its general director since 2012 is Alexey Zyuzin. The chain stops at a Mauritius-registered private company whose owners are not documented in open sources, so the sponsor stays not rated rather than 'none'.
